basic_details.job_title: MERB Lecturer in Architectural Assistantship Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Meghalaya Education Recruitment Board (MERB), Shillong, has invited applications for the post of Lecturer in Architectural Assistantship under Advt No. NO.DHTE/TE/MERB/120/2025/Pt/250. The online application is open from 3 November 2026 to 3 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online: Debit cum ATM cards/ Credit Cards/ Net banking/UPI.

qualification.education_qualification: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Architecture with minimum 60% marks OR Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Architecture and Master's Degree in Architecture or in allied subjects of Architecture with minimum 60% marks at either level
qualification.details: Qualification: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Architecture with minimum 60% marks; OR Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Architecture and Master's Degree in Architecture or in allied subjects of Architecture with minimum 60% marks at either level Age limit: Maximum 32 years (as on 1 November 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, Meghalaya Government employees No age limit, provided they entered service within the prescribed age limit | Other conditions: | Requisite qualification must be acquired as on the last date fixed for submission of applications Date of acquiring qualification is the date the result of the last examination is declared

exam_pattern.details: Written Examination, if held, is in MCQ format

how_to_apply: Apply online through https://rpa.meghalaya.gov.in/rpaonline/; applications through any other mode will be summarily rejected.
Check and update the profile on the portal before applying.
Pay the fee online by Debit cum ATM card, Credit Card, Net banking or UPI.
Submit the online application by 3 December 2026, 23:59 hours, after which the link will be disabled.
important_instructions: Fee is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other purpose Bank's commission may be additionally applicable depending on payment mode Candidates must appear for the Interview at their own expenses For problems with the online application, contact the Directorate of Higher & Technical Education, Meghalaya in person or at [email protected] with phone number False information or impersonation may lead to debarment from MERB examinations

content_sections.heading: MERB Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. NO.DHTE/TE/MERB/120/2025/Pt/250 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download MERB notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Architecture with minimum 60% marks; OR Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Architecture and Master's Degree in Architecture or in allied subjects of Architecture with minimum 60% marks at either level Age limit: Maximum 32 years (as on 1 November 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, Meghalaya Government employees No age limit, provided they entered service within the prescribed age limit Other conditions: Requisite qualification must be acquired as on the last date fixed for submission of applications Date of acquiring qualification is the date the result of the last examination is declared

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for MERB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who have not fulfilled the requisite qualification as on the last date of receipt of application

content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online: Debit cum ATM cards/ Credit Cards/ Net banking/UPI.

content_sections.heading: How Will MERB Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written Examination (MCQ format) followed by Personal Interview OR Short-listing of candidates followed by Personal Interview Preliminary scrutiny followed by a Proposed Rejection/Ineligibility List on the MERB website 15 days allowed to file representation against proposed rejection Short-listing, if used, based on MERB Short-listing norms updated from time to time Only candidates producing all required original documents will be called for Personal Interview

content_sections.heading: MERB Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Written Examination, if held, is in MCQ format

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Date of birth proof: Matriculation/Secondary School Leaving Certificate, an equivalent certificate recognised by an Indian University, certified extract from Board registers, or birth certificate Original certificates of educational qualification, date of birth, caste, community and others for the Personal Interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MERB Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online through https://rpa.meghalaya.gov.in/rpaonline/; applications through any other mode will be summarily rejected. Check and update the profile on the portal before applying. Pay the fee online by Debit cum ATM card, Credit Card, Net banking or UPI. Submit the online application by 3 December 2026, 23:59 hours, after which the link will be disabled.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Fee is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other purpose Bank's commission may be additionally applicable depending on payment mode Candidates must appear for the Interview at their own expenses For problems with the online application, contact the Directorate of Higher & Technical Education, Meghalaya in person or at [email protected] with phone number False information or impersonation may lead to debarment from MERB examinations

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MERB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 3 December 2026. Applications opened on 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in MERB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Lecturer in Architectural Assistantship.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for MERB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: For the post at Sl. 1: Rs. 460. SC/ST who are permanent residents of the State of Meghalaya: Half the rate.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 32 years (as on 1 November 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, Meghalaya Government employees No age limit, provided they entered service within the prescribed age limit.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Requisite qualification must be acquired as on the last date fixed for submission of applications. Date of acquiring qualification is the date the result of the last examination is declared.

faq.answer: Candidates who have not fulfilled the requisite qualification as on the last date of receipt of application.

faq.answer: Written Examination (MCQ format) followed by Personal Interview. OR Short-listing of candidates followed by Personal Interview.
